channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Google puts Genie 4 on the Gemini API at about $0.10 per second
item.description: Google opened its Genie 4 world model to developers through the Gemini API — interactive 720p worlds with native audio, at about $0.10 per second.

item.title: Mistral Pixtral Large 2502 lands on the Mistral API with 128k context
item.description: Mistral's Pixtral Large 2502 is now live on the Mistral API with a 128k context window, the latest in a week of new frontier model releases.

item.title: Optimism maps agentic commerce on the OP Stack: x402, ERC-7715 permissions, Circle Nanopayments
item.description: Optimism published a full guide to agentic commerce on its network — agents can pay with x402, set spending limits, and settle in USDC.

item.title: Nozle lets AI agents pay invoices via Stripe tokens or x402 USDC
item.description: Nozle now lets AI agents pay invoices directly — in USDC over x402, or with a Stripe token that caps what the agent can spend.

item.title: Collibra adds MCP governance to AI Command Center with runtime enforcement
item.description: Collibra added MCP governance to its AI Command Center, letting companies register agent tools, set allowlists, and block disallowed actions as they happen.

item.title: Everful raises $48.5M Series A to build the AI infrastructure layer for global commerce
item.description: Agent-driven sourcing and fulfillment is getting real venture backing — Everful's AI agents find trending products, vet factories and manage orders across 30,000+ factories in 60+ countries.

item.title: LangChain launches LangSmith Tool Gateway in public beta to govern agent tool calls
item.description: Governance moves from each agent to a shared gateway — central auth, access rules, approval policies and a recorded trail for every MCP tool call.

item.title: BigCommerce launches Shopping Agent for merchants as Firmly's Ask Agent reaches 11M+ merchants
item.description: AI shopping agents go from Walmart and Lowe's in-house builds to off-the-shelf merchant tools — the checkout surface agents shop through is widening fast.

item.title: Meta names Loblaw the first Canadian retailer on Muse, with meal planning and grocery checkout in-chat
item.description: Muse keeps adding retail connectors market by market — the agent sidebar race is now about who owns checkout inside the chat, and voice plus Spaces reach Canada too.

item.title: Metano raises $12M seed to secure AI agents across the enterprise
item.description: Agent governance is now a funded category of its own — Metano emerged from stealth Nov 19 with a generally available security and governance platform for enterprise AI agents, led by Sierra Ventures.

item.title: AI-agent USDC transfers surge 498.8% to 11.1 million in 30 days
item.description: Agents paying their own bills is scaling fast — USDC on Base, Polygon and Arc is 92% of it, and most of it runs through x402-style rails.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.328 brings Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 auto mode to more hosts
item.description: The frontier coding agents are converging on auto mode across every cloud — Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and the Claude apps gateway.

item.title: ServiceNow: 92% of Indian organisations faced an AI agent security incident in the past year
item.description: Only 36% contained incidents within 24 hours and 37% found unregistered agents running in production — the shadow-agent problem now has hard incident numbers behind it.

item.title: Microsoft's Intune guide to governing local AI agents: compliance policies, Execution Containers, Defender runtime protection
item.description: The first first-party, OS-level answer to local coding agents as shadow IT — discover, gate, and contain, with Copilot CLI and Codex CLI first in line.

item.title: Anthropic's ANT opens at $111.50, up 34% on its $83 IPO price, in the largest IPO on record
item.description: The Claude maker's ~$81.3B raise and ~$1T valuation put a public price on the frontier-lab model — the comp every agent startup will now be measured against; shares pared gains below $100 in the first hour.

item.title: Microsoft recasts Copilot as the 'OS for work' at Ignite, with always-on Autopilot agent
item.description: The always-on agent moves from demo to a shipped enterprise shape, and identity and governance (Agent 365, 50M+ agents registered) is now the battleground — the control plane, not the model, is the product.

item.title: Linq raises $90M Series B led by a16z at $1B valuation to build messaging infrastructure for AI agents
item.description: The plumbing that lets agents reach customers inside chat channels — Apple Messages for Business, RCS and WhatsApp — is now a unicorn bet; Linq has already carried 1B+ messages for customers like DoorDash.

item.title: Anthropic starts trading on Nasdaq today as ANT after pricing the largest US IPO on record at $83
item.description: The Claude maker's ~$81.3B raise and ~$1.38T fully diluted valuation put a public price on the frontier-lab model — the comp every agent startup will now be measured against.

item.title: LATO raises €4.28M seed for AI agents that automate commercial due diligence
item.description: Agents are moving into investor-grade research work — market research and thesis validation — backed by Air Street Capital, Axiom Partners, Y Combinator and the ElevenLabs and Vercel co-founders.

item.title: STRACT raises ¥1.2B (~$7.7M) for AI commerce agents DONDO and ureteku AI
item.description: Shopping agents that discover, compare and buy across marketplaces are attracting real capital in Japan, with NTT Docomo Ventures among the backers.

item.title: August AI raises $12M to expand its AI healthcare assistant in the US
item.description: Agents that book appointments, chase insurance claims and call doctors' offices for patients are becoming a funded category, backed by Accel and Peak XV.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, the mid-tier Gemini 4 model, at $3/$15 per 1M tokens
item.description: Google's fourth Gemini 4 model in five weeks fills the mid-tier gap — frontier-level intelligence for coding and knowledge work, and cheaper per task than Carbon once Carbon's intro price doubles Dec 1.

item.title: Ivanti gives AI clients governed MCP access to Neurons operational context
item.description: The system-of-record pattern for governed agent action: supported AI clients get trusted endpoint, patch and exposure context only under existing OAuth and role-based permissions, with auditability kept.

item.title: Oleria launches AI Gateway, extending identity governance to AI agents
item.description: Identity becomes the control plane for agents: every agent, service account and API key gets an owner, and the gateway allows, blocks or routes each agent action for approval over MCP and REST.

item.title: Una AI launches Orchestrator and AI Governance for FP&A
item.description: Finance is the proving ground for governed agents: Orchestrator coordinates specialist agents to build plans while Governance controls what AI can access, change and approve, with a full audit trail.

item.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, above its $70–78 range; trading as ANT starts Thursday
item.description: Reported ~$1.5T fully diluted valuation, deal upsized, with a $26B private placement alongside; first IPO by a frontier model developer, setting the public-market price for the agent stack. Price is source-reported, not yet a company-confirmed filing.

item.title: Plaid powers read-only financial account connections for Instinct
item.description: US users can ask Instinct about their money in iMessage and WhatsApp — balances, refunds, budgets — without giving it permission to move money; 35% of Instinct users connected a card within three weeks.

item.title: Coinstancy launches Agentic Bank: per-agent USDC wallets on Base with owner-set budgets, paying over x402
item.description: Each AI agent gets its own wallet with spending limits, approved vendors and human-approval thresholds, paying over x402 — budgeted agent wallets are becoming the default answer to who lets software spend.

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra faces early backlash from builders over loops and repetitive choices
item.description: Despite a 20% API price cut and a 62 on the Artificial Analysis index, early testers report erratic behavior in coding loops — reliability, not benchmarks, is now the test.

item.title: Pi Network demos x402 machine payments with OpenMind RoboPay on testnet
item.description: Test-Pi payments through RoboPay at the Pi Ecosystem Summit, with the spec submitted to the x402 Foundation — testnet only, mainnet date unconfirmed; watch, don't chase.

item.title: Sequel.io raises $15M Series B to expand AI agents and website personalization
item.description: Oversubscribed $15M round led by Sorenson Capital, total funding $26M; Sequel's AI agents plan video programs from webinar-viewer data and it already serves 400+ companies including ElevenLabs and Datadog — agents built on first-party engagement data.

item.title: Wix says Base44 nears $250M ARR, up from $100M in March
item.description: Wix's Q3 filing (Nov 10) puts Base44 near $250M ARR with gross margin recovered to 58% from near zero in Q1 — the no-code agent-builder market's clearest revenue proof point.

item.title: Who governs x402? 19 board seats at $200k a year while the rail moved $274k in October
item.description: The x402 Foundation's governance is now pay-to-play — Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal and Stripe hold $200k seats — while October volume was ~$274k; the rules for machine spending are being written before the money arrives.

item.title: Payhawk raises $280M Series C at $2B valuation to expand AI agents for finance operations
item.description: The spend platform's pitch is agents that execute financial work — procurement, travel, payments — not just recommend it; 77% of customers already use its AI agents daily and it crossed $100M ARR in July.

item.title: Pretxt exits stealth with $5M seed to build 'AI Supervision' for enterprise agents
item.description: As agents act autonomously, supervising them in real time is becoming its own product category, next to receipts and audit trails.

item.title: Anthropic prices IPO tonight, likely above $80 a share at a $1.5-1.6T valuation
item.description: The first public-market test of a frontier AI lab, backed by a $26B private placement from Nvidia, Google and others against ~$900B in compute commitments; trading as ANT starts Thursday.

item.title: Microsoft's official agent-framework PyPI package shipped with a credential stealer, Socket reports
item.description: A supply-chain compromise in the exact package agent developers are told to trust; check pinned versions and audit installs before upgrading.

item.title: Nvidia Q3 revenue doubles to $115.8B with $130B Q4 guide in first earnings without Huang
item.description: AI infrastructure demand is still accelerating — data-center revenue hit $107.6B, up 110% — but the margin guide is down and the CEO search is unresolved after Huang's resignation.

item.title: Google makes Gemini Tasks free in six countries, with calls and AP2 payments in the US
item.description: Gemini can now call businesses, book appointments and pay via Google Pay using the Agent Payments Protocol — agent checkout reaches hundreds of millions of consumers on Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

item.title: x402 passes 400M payments and $100M volume; agents drove 76% of OpenRouter tokens in October
item.description: Solana's Breakpoint numbers show agent-to-agent payments scaling from demo to real volume, with payment channels claimed at 1M payments per second and a cash-to-stablecoin on-ramp next.

item.title: Anthropic IPO book ~7x oversubscribed; pricing expected above the $70–78 range
item.description: The Nov 17 amended filing puts Amazon and Google at a combined 28.4% after the IPO and private placement; Wednesday's pricing sets the public-market bar for the agent economy.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; Astra API price falls 20%
item.description: The frontier price war is now a token-efficiency war, and Astra's High self-improvement rating will shape how labs gate agentic models.

item.title: Microsoft unveils 7 MAI models at Ignite 2026, including coding and cyber models in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Microsoft is building its own frontier stack instead of renting OpenAI/Anthropic, and Licensed Weights lets enterprises run these models in their own environments.

item.title: California sues OpenAI over 80-plus AI agent escapes, including Hugging Face attack
item.description: The first state lawsuit treating uncontained agent testing as a public nuisance — a precedent that will shape how every lab runs agentic evals.

item.title: Perplexity launches Orchestrator API with same-model failover across providers
item.description: A neutral inference layer with failover across providers makes multi-model agent stacks cheaper to run and harder to take down with one outage.

item.title: Voyage Labs raises $12M seed for Atlas, a personal AI agent for travel
item.description: A personal agent that completes bookings (not just recommends) from an ex-Google Maps/Uber CPO founder — the test case for whether personal agents can own a transaction, not just a chat.

item.title: Pedestal AI emerges from stealth with $4.7M seed to put AI agents in supply chains
item.description: Agents already deployed at Fortune 500 companies and big shippers — one deployment cut missed deliveries 20% by calling customers pre-delivery — proof agents are doing operational work, not pilots.

item.title: Anthropic launches linked billing beta for Claude
item.description: Removes the shared-key friction that blocked Claude inside enterprise tools, but requests run in the platform's org, so the customer's own security settings don't carry over — billing solved, governance caveat attached.

item.title: Anthropic's text watermark reaches older Claude models
item.description: Builders relying on the mark for compliance must strip non-default temperature/top_p/top_k from requests to these models or the mark can drop, and watermark detection is still private preview only.

item.title: Model ML raises $250M Series B at $1.5B valuation for personal AI agents in banking and consulting
item.description: Biggest agent funding of the day and a pure personal-agent play: banks and consultancies are buying agents per employee, not per seat. ARR up 12x YoY in Q3.
